rationale: System documentation is the control the pipeline source reads better than the runtime source does, and it is the shape of the argument for most of the SA family: administrator and user documentation describing secure configuration, installation, operation and effective use is a set of documents, and a repository is a document store under version control with authorship, review and a content hash per commit. rampscan can evidence that the documents exist at named paths, that they are non-empty, when they last changed, which commit changed them and who reviewed that change — the existence, currency and integrity half of the control, anchored the same way every other claim here is anchored.
remainder: Distribution: the control requires the documentation to reach defined personnel or roles, and no commit records that anyone received or read it — the same gap upstream names for every policy control, and it is not closed by the document being public.
